questions.question: What does Israel say in Psalm 129?
options: Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed
My many enemies have surrounded me on every side and have won
The LORD has dealt very bountifully with me throughout the whole of my days
I have been wholly forsaken and forgotten by every one of my friends
questions.answer: Greatly have they afflicted me from my youth, yet they have not prevailed

questions.question: To what does the psalm wish the enemies of Zion be like?
options: Wax before the fire that melts and is gone
Dust on the road that the rain washes away
Chaff on the threshing floor that the wind blows away
Grass on the housetops that withers before it grows
questions.answer: Grass on the housetops that withers before it grows

questions.question: The psalm declares the LORD is righteous and has cut the cords of the wicked.
Greatly have they afflicted me from my _____, yet they have not prevailed against me.
The LORD is righteous; he has cut the cords of the _____.
